biography.value:
Published alignment: CE/CN.

Description

A crown of cruel horns surrounds the head of this mighty young dragon. Thick scales the color of molten rock cover its long body.

Defense

AC 21, touch 12, flat-footed 19 (+2 dex, +9 natural)

hp 94 (9d12+27)

mp 34

Fort +9, Ref +8, Will +12

DR 5/magic; Immune Fire, Paralysis, Sleep; Resist Ice 50%

Weakness Water

Offense

Speed 60 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)

Melee Bite +14 (1d8+7), 2 Claws +14 (1d6+5), 2 Wings +9 (1d4+2)

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (30-ft. cone, 4d10 fire damage, Reflex DC 17 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Fireball, Healing Flame

Spells Known (FC CL 9th, Concentration +14)

At will - bleed, detect magic, ignite, mending, message, read magic, torchlight

1st (DC 16) - detonate, fire

2nd (DC 17) - detonate II, elemental resistance, fire II, see invisibility

3rd (DC 18) - detonate III, dispel, fira, fire III, haste

Statistics

Str 21, Dex 14, Con 17, Int 12, Wis 18, Cha 12

Base Atk +9; CMB +14; CMD 26 (30 vs. trip)

Feats Cleave, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Power Attack, Vital Strike

Skills Appraise +13, Bluff +13, Fly +14, Intimidate +13, Perception +16, Spellcraft +13, Stealth +14

Languages Common, Draconic

ffd20-bestiary-builder.sourceText: Breath Weapon (30-ft. cone, 4d10 fire damage, Reflex DC 17 half, usable every 1d4 rounds)

description.value: As a standard action within 760 ft., a red dragon generates a searing explosion of flame that detonates with a low roar and deals 5d8 points of fire damage to every creature within the 20-ft.-radius. Every creature caught in the explosion must make a Reflex save (DC 18) to take half damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, the red dragon manifests a sacred flame beneath his foe up to 30 feet away, dealing 6d6 points of damage (half holy/fire) and heals himself for half the damage dealt. The target must make a successful Fortitude save (DC 18) to take half damage and the red dragon does not gain any hit points. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

save.description: Half damage and no healing. On failure the caster heals half of the damage actually dealt.

effect: Save: half damage, no healing. Failure: heal dragon half damage actually dealt.
Roll once. Half is fire; the remainder is light. Apply each recipient's defenses to its shares.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

description.value: A red dragon can see perfectly in smoky conditions.

effect: See perfectly in smoky conditions; smoke alone does not grant concealment.
